title: Story premise ENT109: The Space Station’s Missing Down
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (fantasy and science fiction). Hook: Which way is the welcome upside down? Takeaway/theme: A shared space may need more than one intended viewpoint.
description: A toy astronaut wants to hang a welcome sign, but in the fantasy station every visitor arrives from a different wall. They replace the one-direction sign with a slowly rotating ring of repeated WELCOME text, then add matching floor symbols so each arrival can orient to a chosen route.
